purpose: Evidence-ready working file for LORE Crypto History. This file is intentionally separate from oversized events.json.

entries.title: Tesla reveals a $1.5 billion Bitcoin purchase
entries.summary: Tesla disclosed in its 2020 Form 10-K that it had updated its investment policy in January 2021 and subsequently invested an aggregate $1.5 billion in Bitcoin.
entries.significance: One of the world's most visible public companies added Bitcoin to its balance sheet, dramatically accelerating the corporate-treasury narrative.

entries.title: Tesla begins accepting Bitcoin for vehicle purchases
entries.summary: Tesla began accepting Bitcoin as payment for vehicles in selected regions during the first quarter of 2021.
entries.significance: For a brief period, Bitcoin could be used directly to buy one of the world's most recognizable consumer products from a major public company.

entries.title: Tesla suspends Bitcoin vehicle payments
entries.summary: Tesla later disclosed that it suspended Bitcoin payments in May 2021.
entries.significance: The reversal intensified the global debate over Bitcoin mining's environmental impact and showed how a single corporate policy change could move crypto markets.

entries.title: Beeple's Everydays sells for $69.3 million
entries.summary: Christie's sold Beeple's Everydays: The First 5000 Days for $69,346,250.
entries.significance: The sale forced NFTs and purely digital art into the highest tier of the traditional art market and became the defining art-market moment of the NFT boom.

entries.title: Coinbase goes public by direct listing
entries.summary: Coinbase Global's Class A shares began public trading on Nasdaq through a direct listing on 14 April 2021.
entries.significance: A crypto-native exchange entering the US public markets was a landmark convergence of cryptocurrency and traditional capital markets.

entries.title: Bored Ape Yacht Club launches
entries.summary: Yuga Labs launched Bored Ape Yacht Club with a week-long presale of 10,000 NFTs priced at 0.08 ETH each; the remaining supply sold out on 1 May.
entries.significance: BAYC transformed the profile-picture NFT into a membership, identity and commercial-brand model and became a defining symbol of the 2021 NFT boom.

sources.title: Yuga Labs — Let's Make A NFT

entries.title: Uniswap v3 launches
entries.summary: Uniswap v3 deployed to Ethereum mainnet with concentrated liquidity and redesigned liquidity-provider positions.
entries.significance: Concentrated liquidity materially improved AMM capital efficiency and influenced a generation of decentralized-exchange design.

entries.title: China formalizes a nationwide crackdown on cryptocurrency mining
entries.summary: China's National Development and Reform Commission and other agencies issued a notice requiring controls on new virtual-currency mining projects and the orderly exit of existing projects.
entries.significance: The crackdown displaced a huge share of global Bitcoin mining capacity and accelerated the geographic redistribution of Bitcoin hash rate.

entries.title: China declares cryptocurrency-related business activities illegal financial activities
entries.summary: The People's Bank of China and nine other authorities stated that virtual-currency exchange, trading, intermediation, token financing and related services constituted illegal financial activity.
entries.significance: The notice represented China's most comprehensive national prohibition of domestic crypto trading-related business activity to that point.

entries.title: El Salvador makes Bitcoin legal tender
entries.summary: El Salvador's Bitcoin law took effect on 7 September 2021, giving Bitcoin legal-tender status alongside the US dollar.
entries.significance: El Salvador became the first country to adopt Bitcoin as legal tender, taking cryptocurrency from private-market adoption into national monetary policy.

sources.title: IMF — El Salvador 2021 Article IV mission

entries.title: Ethereum London upgrade activates EIP-1559
entries.summary: Ethereum's London upgrade activated at block 12,965,000, introducing EIP-1559's base-fee mechanism and fee burning.
entries.significance: EIP-1559 redesigned Ethereum's transaction-fee market and introduced a protocol-level ETH burn, materially changing Ethereum's monetary mechanics.

entries.title: Poly Network suffers a $612 million cross-chain exploit
entries.summary: An attacker exploited Poly Network and removed roughly $612 million in assets, then began returning funds the following day.
entries.significance: At the time it was the largest DeFi theft and became uniquely famous because the attacker returned nearly all of the assets.

entries.title: Arbitrum One launches publicly
entries.summary: Arbitrum One launched publicly on 31 August 2021 as an optimistic-rollup Ethereum layer 2.
entries.significance: Arbitrum became one of Ethereum's dominant rollup networks and a central part of the ecosystem's scaling strategy.

entries.title: Optimism deploys OP Mainnet
entries.summary: Optimism deployed OP Mainnet in January 2021 and later opened the network to permissionless deployment.
entries.significance: Optimism was one of the first major production optimistic rollups and helped establish the rollup-centric Ethereum scaling model.

entries.title: Solana network goes offline for 17 hours
entries.summary: Solana stopped confirming blocks for around 17 hours after transaction flooding caused memory pressure and validator failures.
entries.significance: The outage became the defining reliability controversy of Solana's 2021 growth phase and a recurring point in decentralization debates.

sources.title: Solana Foundation — 9-14 Network Outage Initial Overview

entries.title: Axie Infinity's play-to-earn economy explodes
entries.summary: Axie reported growth from 20,000 daily active users in February to 250,000 by June and toward 3 million by December, alongside huge marketplace and protocol revenue growth.
entries.significance: Axie turned play-to-earn from a crypto niche into a global gaming/economic phenomenon, particularly in markets such as the Philippines.

entries.title: Visa buys CryptoPunk 7610
entries.summary: Visa announced that it had purchased CryptoPunk 7610 to learn firsthand how institutions could acquire, custody and use NFTs.
entries.significance: A global payments company purchasing a CryptoPunk was a striking validation moment for NFTs as digital cultural assets.

sources.title: Visa — NFTs mark a new chapter for digital commerce

entries.title: Ethereum Beacon Chain Altair upgrade activates
entries.summary: Altair activated at epoch 74,240 as the first scheduled upgrade of Ethereum's Beacon Chain.
entries.significance: Altair advanced the live proof-of-stake chain toward The Merge and added sync-committee support and stronger validator penalties.

entries.title: ENS launches its governance token and DAO airdrop
entries.summary: ENS launched the ENS governance token and DAO, with an airdrop available to eligible historical .eth registrants.
entries.significance: The airdrop became one of the defining examples of retroactive community ownership and turned a naming protocol into a large token-governed DAO.

entries.title: ConstitutionDAO raises tens of millions but loses the Constitution auction
entries.summary: ConstitutionDAO crowdfunded more than $40 million in crypto to bid on a rare first printing of the US Constitution but did not win the Sotheby's auction.
entries.significance: The week-long experiment became one of the clearest demonstrations of internet-native capital formation and single-purpose DAO coordination.

entries.title: Bitcoin Taproot activates
entries.summary: Taproot activated at Bitcoin block 709,632, introducing Schnorr signatures, Taproot outputs and Tapscript rules.
entries.significance: Bitcoin's first major consensus upgrade since SegWit expanded privacy and smart-contract flexibility while activating without a contentious chain split.

entries.title: Bitcoin reaches the 2021 cycle high near $69,000
entries.summary: CoinDesk market data recorded Bitcoin trading close to $69,000 on 10 November 2021.
entries.significance: The record became the symbolic peak of the 2020-2021 bull cycle before the long 2022 downturn.
entries.notes: Exact all-time-high value varies by exchange and price index.

entries.title: Visa settles a transaction in USDC on Ethereum
entries.summary: Visa announced that Crypto.com had settled part of its obligations to Visa using USD Coin sent to Visa's Ethereum address via Anchorage.
entries.significance: The pilot connected a major card network's treasury settlement system directly to a public blockchain and stablecoin.

entries.title: Ronin mainnet launches for Axie Infinity
entries.summary: Sky Mavis launched Ronin, its Ethereum sidechain, beginning with migration of Axie land and item assets.
entries.significance: Ronin removed Ethereum fee constraints from Axie and was a critical infrastructure step behind the game's explosive 2021 growth.

entries.title: First US Bitcoin futures ETF begins trading
entries.summary: ProShares Bitcoin Strategy ETF (BITO) began trading on NYSE Arca on 19 October 2021, investing primarily in CME Bitcoin futures rather than spot Bitcoin.
entries.significance: BITO was the first US exchange-traded fund linked to Bitcoin and opened a regulated brokerage-account route to Bitcoin exposure years before spot ETFs.

entries.title: Facebook rebrands to Meta and puts the metaverse at the center of its strategy
entries.summary: Facebook, Inc. changed its corporate name to Meta Platforms, Inc. and said the company would become 'metaverse-first.'
entries.significance: The rebrand pushed the metaverse concept into mainstream corporate culture and intensified speculation around virtual worlds, NFTs and metaverse tokens.

entries.title: Anchor Protocol goes live on Terra
entries.summary: Anchor's web application was live by March 2021, allowing users to deposit Terra stablecoins, borrow against bonded assets and participate in governance.
entries.significance: Anchor's high stablecoin yields later became central to UST demand and therefore to the build-up preceding Terra's 2022 collapse.

entries.title: Solana's growth collides with a 17-hour network outage
entries.summary: Bots flooding a Raydium IDO caused validator memory pressure and consensus failure, leaving Solana unable to confirm blocks for about 17 hours.
entries.significance: The outage became the defining reliability controversy of Solana's rapid 2021 expansion.

entries.title: ENS DAO and ENS token launch
entries.summary: ENS launched its governance token and DAO on 8 November 2021, opening an airdrop claim to eligible .eth registrants.
entries.significance: The event became a flagship example of retroactive community ownership and protocol governance through an airdrop.

entries.title: Visa purchases CryptoPunk 7610
entries.summary: Visa purchased CryptoPunk 7610, saying it wanted firsthand experience acquiring, custodying and using NFTs.
entries.significance: A global payments company buying a CryptoPunk was one of the clearest institutional validation moments of NFT culture.

sources.title: Visa — NFTs mark a new chapter for digital commerce

entries.title: Ethereum Altair upgrade activates
entries.summary: Altair activated at Beacon Chain epoch 74,240, adding sync committees and strengthening validator penalty parameters.
entries.significance: Altair was the Beacon Chain's first scheduled mainnet upgrade and an important step toward The Merge.
